subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**apartment.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In blank 2, the name of the housing place would be appropriate.
 
• **In the passage, the subject explains how the house that she lives inn now is an independent place on the third floor**.
 
 
• Thus, the options 1, 3 and 4 will be incorrect.
 
 
 
• Now **the word "apartment" means a room or set of rooms fitted especially with housekeeping facilities and usually leased as a dwelling.**
 
 
• Example: I'm looking for a furnished apartment.
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that the word in option 2 is correct in blank 3.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
